014package org.microbean.bean;
015
016import java.util.List;
017import java.util.Objects;
018
019import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
020
021import java.util.function.BiFunction;
022import java.util.function.Function;
023
024public interface Reducible<C, T> {
025
026  public T reduce(final C criteria);
027
028  public static <C, E> Reducible<C, E> of(final Selectable<C, E> selectable,
029                                          final Reducer<C, E> r) {
030    return of(selectable, r, Reducer::fail);
031  }
032
033  public static <C, E> Reducible<C, E> of(final Selectable<C, E> selectable,
034                                          final Reducer<C, E> r,
035                                          final BiFunction<? super List<? extends E>, ? super C, ? extends E> failureHandler) {
036    Objects.requireNonNull(selectable, "selectable");
037    Objects.requireNonNull(r, "r");
038    final BiFunction<? super List<? extends E>, ? super C, ? extends E> fh =
039      failureHandler == null ? Reducer::fail : failureHandler;
040    return c -> r.reduce(selectable.select(c), c, fh);
041  }
042
043  public static <C, E> Reducible<C, E> ofCaching(final Selectable<C, E> selectable,
044                                                 final Reducer<C, E> r) {
045    return ofCaching(selectable, r, Reducer::fail);
046  }
047
048  public static <C, E> Reducible<C, E> ofCaching(final Selectable<C, E> selectable,
049                                                 final Reducer<C, E> r,
050                                                 final BiFunction<? super List<? extends E>, ? super C, ? extends E> failureHandler) {
051    return ofCaching(selectable, r, failureHandler, new ConcurrentHashMap<C, E>()::computeIfAbsent);
052  }
053
054  public static <C, E> Reducible<C, E> ofCaching(final Selectable<C, E> selectable,
055                                                 final Reducer<C, E> r,
056                                                 final BiFunction<? super List<? extends E>, ? super C, ? extends E> failureHandler,
057                                                 final BiFunction<? super C, Function<C, E>, ? extends E> computeIfAbsent) {
058    final Reducible<C, E> rd = of(selectable, r, failureHandler);
059    return c -> computeIfAbsent.apply(c, rd::reduce);
060  }
061
062}
